Important Dates

  • Exam Name : Combined Defence Services Examination (II), 2026
  • Exam Date : 13 September 2026
  • Answer Key Release Date : 16 September 2026

How to Download Answer Key

  2. Click on the answer key link.
  3. Select your exam date / shift / paper code.
  4. Download the answer key PDF.
